name: EventSchedulerService
description: Provides time-based automation and scheduling for smart home devices. Supports natural language time parsing (e.g., '10 PM', '20 minutes'), cron expressions for recurring events, and duration-based actions. Integrates with all device types including Bluetooth, UPnP, printers, and sensors.

actions.name: createSchedule
actions.description: Create a new scheduled event. Parameters: name, deviceId, action, time (natural language or cron), duration (optional), recurring (optional).

actions.name: listSchedules
actions.description: List all scheduled events with their status and next execution time.

actions.name: getSchedule
actions.description: Get detailed information about a specific schedule. Parameters: id.

actions.name: updateSchedule
actions.description: Update an existing schedule. Parameters: id, plus any fields to update (name, time, action, etc.).

actions.name: deleteSchedule
actions.description: Delete a scheduled event. Parameters: id.

actions.name: enableSchedule
actions.description: Enable a disabled schedule. Parameters: id.

actions.name: disableSchedule
actions.description: Disable a schedule without deleting it. Parameters: id.

actions.name: executeNow
actions.description: Immediately execute a scheduled event. Parameters: id.

actions.name: getStatus
actions.description: Get scheduler status including active schedules, next execution times, and statistics.

features: Natural language time parsing ('10 PM', 'in 20 minutes', 'tomorrow at 3 PM')
Cron expression support for recurring events
Multi-device type support (Bluetooth, UPnP, printers, sensors)

examples.description: Turn on light at 10 PM for 20 minutes
Water plants every day at 6 AM
Turn off all outlets at midnight
